description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Marker' which is a marker used for indicating data points on a graph within the Image_Graph PHP library. It includes methods for setting size, setting a secondary marker, and drawing the marker.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Marker
classes.description: A class representing a marker that can be used to mark data points in a graph, supporting secondary markers and customizable size.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Marker
methods.description: Constructor that calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the marker, with meaning specific to implementation.

methods.name: setSecondaryMarker
methods.description: Sets a secondary marker and links it back to this marker.

methods.name: _drawMarker
methods.description: Draws the marker at given coordinates, optionally with values.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Indicates completion of the drawing process, returns true.
